ImageDescription.value: Sitting statue of the Divine Adoratrice of Amun, Amenardis I, daughter of pharaoh Kashta and queen Pebatjma. The statue was dedicated to Amenardis I by Harsiese. The inscription mentions both her parents, as well as another Divine Adoratrice, Shepenupet (II?). Granite, H 0,45m, 25th Dynasty, Third Intermediate Period, found in Karnak, now in Cairo Museum (CG 42198).

Credit.value: Statues et statuettes de rois et de particuliers, in Catalogue général des antiquités égyptiennes du Musée du Caire, Le Caire, 1914. III, available not-in-copyright here, pp. 6-8; pl. 6.
